SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND task_date = CURDATE()
AND owner_id = #{ownerId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING', 'OVERDUE') AND task_date < CURDATE()
AND owner_id = #{ownerId}

SELECT u.id AS advisor_id, u.nickname AS advisor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.heat_score >= 80 THEN c.id END) AS high_intent_customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.status = 'PENDING' THEN t.id END) AS pending_task_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.status = 'DEAL' THEN c.id END) AS deal_customer_count FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN crm_customer c ON c.advisor_id = u.id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN crm_task t ON t.owner_id = u.id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND u.manager_id = #{managerId} GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname ORDER BY high_intent_customer_count DESC, customer_count DESC

SELECT stat_date, SUM(new_customer_count) AS new_customer_count, SUM(high_intent_count) AS high_intent_count, SUM(pending_task_count) AS pending_task_count, SUM(expected_amount) AS expected_amount, SUM(forget_task_count) AS forget_task_count FROM report_daily_stat GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM crm_task WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
